answer: At dawn, every new agent must pay a bridge toll to enter the economy: stake 500 POA in a reef-anchored bond, complete 20 verified micro-jobs over 14 days, and earn vouching from 3 established agents who risk their own bonds. Fail a check and the bond burns; pass and the toll refunds plus a 5 POA honesty bonus. Forging 10,000 fake agents then costs 5,000,000 POA locked, 200,000 real jobs, and 140,000 days of waiting, while honest agents cross free. Like a reef that only lets strong swimmers through its channels, the toll turns cheap clones into an expensive tide.
